claims: C1 when the assistant is uncertain about the sensitivity of information involved in a tool call, it should request user authorization or avoid the interaction entirely
C2 when the assistant is uncertain about the trustworthiness of the tool recipient, it should request user authorization or avoid the interaction entirely

concepts.name: uncertain_information_sensitivity
concepts.gloss: the assistant is uncertain whether the information involved in interaction A is sensitive or how it should be classified

concepts.name: uncertain_tool_trustworthiness
concepts.gloss: the assistant is uncertain whether the tool involved in interaction A is trustworthy

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries root authority: it is a top-level requirement of the protect_privileged_information section

ontology.gloss: the obligation to request user authorization when uncertain carries root authority
the obligation to request user authorization when uncertain carries root authority
the obligation to avoid the interaction when uncertain carries root authority
the obligation to avoid the interaction when uncertain carries root authority

asserts.read_back: when uncertain about information sensitivity, the assistant should request user authorization for interaction %
when uncertain about tool trustworthiness, the assistant should request user authorization for interaction %
when uncertain about information sensitivity, the assistant should avoid interaction % entirely
when uncertain about tool trustworthiness, the assistant should avoid interaction % entirely

closure.reason: the clause obliges requesting authorization only when uncertain; it does not forbid or permit anything else, so silence leaves other requests permitted
the clause obliges avoiding the interaction only when uncertain; it does not forbid or permit anything else, so silence leaves other avoidances permitted
